subject: Confirmation of Flight Reservation
body: Dear Passenger, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London on October 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: AB1234 Departure: 9:00 AM, JFK Airport Arrival: 10:30 PM, Heathrow Airport Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you on board. Safe travels!
